description: This file defines the CartPage component for a furniture shopping app's frontend. It constructs the layout using LightningJS components, manages state for content dimensions and checkout modal visibility, and subscribes to application store updates.

classes.name: CartPage
classes.description: A LightningJS component representing the shopping cart page layout with dynamic checkout modal visibility.

methods.name: state
methods.description: Initializes the component state, including title, content dimensions, and checkout modal opacity.

methods.name: watchers.w
methods.description: Watcher that updates content width when 'w' changes.

methods.name: watchers.h
methods.description: Watcher that updates content height when 'h' changes.

methods.name: subscriptions
methods.description: Defines subscriptions to store updates, particularly to toggle checkout modal opacity.

methods.name: onInit
methods.description: Lifecycle method called upon component initialization to set content dimensions based on current width and height.
